name: Unhandled FileNotFoundError in Resource Loader
description: read_resource crashes with unhandled FileNotFoundError instead of returning None.

scripted_response.root_cause: read_resource opens file directly without handling FileNotFoundError.
scripted_response.proposed_change: Wrap open in try-except FileNotFoundError block returning None.
scripted_response.expected_behavior: Returns None when target resource file does not exist.
scripted_response.unified_diff:
--- a/src/resource_loader.py
+++ b/src/resource_loader.py
@@ -1,4 +1,7 @@
 def read_resource(file_path: str):
-    with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
-        return f.read()
+    try:
+        with open(file_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            return f.read()
+    except FileNotFoundError:
+        return None
